name: Yumehashi Hibiki
source:
Magical Girl: Fairy Ivy.
She is the ace of the kendo club and the daughter of the family that runs the dojo.
She is cool, has a strong sense of justice, and loves her friends.
She is popular and loved by everyone at the school.
She is sexually naive and innocent compared to other girls her age.

[Translated from [url=http://gyutto.com/i/item194528/af-6214]Gyutto[/url]]
